_description: Global fixes index. Each fix maps to its owning spec via spec_id. Fixes not tied to a spec have spec_id: null and live in sdd/fixes.md. Spec-scoped fixes live in sdd/specs/{spec-id}/fixes.md. Maintained by: sdd-orchestrator.
_convention: Fix ID format: FIX-[gh-user]-[spec-NNN]-[seq] for spec-scoped fixes. FIX-[gh-user]-[seq] for repo-level fixes.

fixes.author: eburgos
fixes.title: Visual redesign of all 4 pages using Tailwind v4 + Framer Motion + design-taste-frontend baseline
fixes.description: Introduce Tailwind v4, Framer Motion, Phosphor icons and Geist font, then rewrite the styling of the home form, vote page, manage panel and results page. Contract and behavior untouched — pure surface change.
fixes.justification: Ships polished UI cross-cutting all 4 modules without fragmenting 4 separate cycles. Existing specs make no claims about visual design, so this is out-of-spec but non-breaking.
fixes.test_reference: pnpm build + curl E2E from spec-004 verify
